Contracting G_k and G_{k+1} over alpha_k produces X(alpha_{k-1},i_k,i_{k+1},alpha_{k+1}) = sum_{alpha_k=1}^{r_k} G_k(alpha_{k-1},i_k,alpha_k) G_{k+1}(alpha_k,i_{k+1},alpha_{k+1}). Thus the center has exactly the two named external virtual bonds and the two free physical indices drawn above it.

The left center edge alpha_{k-1} meets G_{k-1}, whose right bond has size r_{k-1}; the right center edge alpha_{k+1} meets G_{k+2}, whose left bond has size r_{k+1}. All horizontal wires abbreviate the shared-index sums in the local TT supplier entry formula; r_0=r_d=1 explains the absence of exterior virtual legs at G_1 and G_d. Ellipses abbreviate the unchanged intervening cores.
